verdict.rationale: Supabase documents automatic daily backups for Pro, Team and Enterprise projects, with 7, 14 or up to 30 days of retention by plan. It also offers Point-in-Time Recovery built on physical backups plus WAL archiving, which can restore to within seconds. A community report from the Supabase CEO notes that nightly pg_dump backups caused midnight write contention on a write-heavy customer, a reliability caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: backups and PITR are not available on the Free plan, PITR is a paid add-on, no detailed restore-workflow or RPO/RTO documentation is in the pack, and there is no independent hands-on confirmation of a successful restore.
